messages:
maya (devex): heads-up — onboarding flow is surfacing raw HTTP stacktraces to end users when auth or gateway errors happen. saw a new user get a full python stack: 

maya (devex): repro snippet and log below — curious if this is coming from the SDK or the gateway. cc @sam (sdk)

```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer bad_token\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

```py
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 502 Server Error: Bad Gateway for url: https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/models.py\", line 940, in raise_for_status
    raise HTTPError(http_error_msg, response=self)
  File \"/app/rwi_client.py\", line 82, in generate
    resp.raise_for_status()
```

sam (sdk): ugh — thanks for the report. this looks like the raw `requests` exception bubbling up because our python client currently re-raises the underlying exception in `generate()` when status >= 400. not great for onboarding UX. :grimace:

li (platform): we started returning 502s with body `{\"error\": \"upstream timeout\"}` from the gateway when the model pool is overloaded. the body is small but SDK shouldn't surface the full stack. we should map statuses -> typed exceptions with friendly user_message.

jorge (eng-runtime): fwiw the runtime intentionally returns the traceback on internal builds for debugging, but PROD strips it. are these tokens from prod?

maya (devex): yes, this was prod. user saw the stack inside the client error window in our quickstart app. bad for first impression. :bug:

sam (sdk): proposal for exception surface (parity across python + js):
- ApiError (base): fields `http_status`, `user_message`, `retryable`
- AuthError (401): `user_message`: \"invalid credentials\"
- RateLimitError (429): `retry_after` in seconds + `retryable`: true
- TemporaryServiceError (5xx): `retryable`: true, `user_message`: \"service temporarily unavailable, try again\"
- BadRequestError (4xx): include `field_errors` if present

Example payload the SDK returns to callers:
```json
{"status":502, "code":"temporary_service_error", "user_message":"Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again.", "retryable":true}
```

sam (sdk): exceptions should not include raw stack/text by default. devs who opt-in to debug mode can request `client.debug=true` to surface more.

li (platform): sounds good. also we should standardize on `retry_after` vs `retry_in_ms` — prefer seconds in headers `Retry-After` integer seconds. :+1:

maya (devex): i'll update the onboarding quickstart to catch `TemporaryServiceError` and show a user-friendly banner + retry button. will also add a small sample app demonstrating backoff. will file a bug for the quickstart UX. GH-3412: https://internal.redwood/gh/3412

sam (sdk): i'll implement exception mapping in python and ts SDKs. PR will add tests asserting no raw stack in `str(e)` for common status codes. ETA EOD for python patch. :rocket:

jorge (eng-runtime): i'll add a gateway flag to ensure prod never includes internal tracebacks in responses. also will emit a short `error_code` in the response body so SDKs don't have to parse text.

deploy-bot: deploy/production gateway-config updated by jorge — 1768322100 — status: success

sam (sdk): quick follow-up — should we include a small machine-readable `error_hint` for UX decisions? e.g., `{\"error_code\":\"POOL_EXHAUSTED\", \"retryable\":true}`

li (platform): yes, `error_code` is helpful. add to public error contract docs and console.

maya (devex): thanks team. i'll update docs + onboarding sample. filing small follow-ups: sample app to show graceful handling, SDK release notes, and an entry in the onboarding checklist to verify no raw stack surface. :thumbsup:
